rca of the issue: Prior bug: differentialResults objects use 'probabilityScore' internally; save() and downstream displays looked for 'probability' which was undefined -> NaN%. Fix adds fallback chain (probabilityScore || probability || matchScore || 0) in DifferentialPage save payload, and (d.probability || d.probabilityScore || 0) in CasesPage/pdfExport. Confirmed by direct UI observation: no 'NaN' substring found in any page or PDF output; all percentages are valid integers.
